Lounge layout, an important reminder at handover
We write to travelers

Travelers, know this: the Companion Animal Travel Desk will check your pet papers, crate setup, and handover details before boarding.

Traveling with pets should feel calm, not confusing. <<FACT F067>> Bring the right crate, keep your animal secure, and follow staff guidance so the handoff stays smooth and fair for everyone.

Some animals need extra steps, and some fees may apply. <<FACT F060>> If your plans change or a problem comes up in transit, let the desk know right away so we can guide you on the next move. <<FACT F120>>

For clear help and the latest travel rules, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
